_why: The colours BOTH the JS theme and the native Android config need: the adaptive icon background and the splash screen, in each scheme. app.config.ts is transpiled and evaluated by plain Node, which cannot require a .ts module, so it cannot import theme.ts - and duplicating the hex there is how the brand colour drifts. JSON is the only format both loaders read. theme.ts remains the single source components read from; this is its native-side spelling, and theme.ts imports these two values from here rather than the other way round.
